name: Taira Mitsuo
source:
Born on August 8, 1989.
Although he has a large physique, he is a kind-hearted sportsman who hates unnecessary violence and bullying. He has a habit of collecting sets of things, but he tends to get bored easily and often stops collecting them. His tastes in women also change often. He formed the legendary calvary team alongside Shiomi Keiichiro and Ibuki Ginpei.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
